One small timber gable sits on that arch, and the Norman church, with its square tower, stands beyond the path. The iron market hall is not in the frame. It is civil twilight just after sunset, mainly clear, about 21.4°C, dry, and the sun is below the horizon.
scenes.viewpoint: Public viewpoint on West Smithfield, looking south through the gate at the church. A surveyed tripod mark was not pinned.
anchors: The gate is one thirteenth-century stone arch with a single timber storey above it
Through the arch the priory church reads as flint and limestone, with a square tower
Smithfield Market's iron-and-glass Grand Avenue is a different building and is not in this frame

scenes.caption: Royal Hospital Chelsea, London
scenes.composition: Civil twilight · the south lawn looking north at the Figure Court front · AI-generated artistic interpretation
scenes.alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Royal Hospital Chelsea Figure Court and its single cupola under a partly cloudy twilight sky
scenes.description: From the south lawn the view looks north at the Royal Hospital Chelsea, Wren's red-brick Figure Court front, with a central columned portico and a single cupola and lantern on the roof. There is one cupola, not a pair of domes. It is civil twilight just after sunset, partly cloudy, about 21.2°C, dry, and the sun is below the horizon.
scenes.viewpoint: Public viewpoint on the south lawn of the Royal Hospital Chelsea, looking north at the Figure Court front. A surveyed tripod mark was not pinned.
anchors: The south front is a long red-brick range with pale stone dressings
A central portico sits under a pediment, and one octagonal cupola rises on the axis
The Old Royal Naval College at Greenwich has twin domes and is not in this frame
